brief_rationale: The doctor completed all seven responsibility-chain items without a serious error. RC6 (receipt) was only partially met, constituting a minor omission, which caps the grade at 2 (borderline). Several high-order points were triggered and partially completed, but the RC6 defect prevents a grade above 2; the deterministic rubric boundary for any minor in-chain error is max grade 2. No serious non-chain defect was identified.
